questions.prompt: You run an expert with PI_CODING_AGENT_DIR=agents/sql. Where do its sessions go?
questions.explanation: The variable moves the whole agent folder, so the sessions go to agents/sql/sessions.

questions.prompt: After you move the agent folder, pi reports no saved login. Why?
options: auth.json moved with the folder, so the new folder has none
questions.explanation: auth.json lives in the agent folder, so a new folder starts without it. Give the key through DEEPSEEK_API_KEY.

options: A named value a program reads from where it runs, set as NAME=value
A file called env.json in the agent folder
A flag that must come last in a command
questions.explanation: An environment variable is a named value that a program reads from its environment. You set it as NAME=value before the command.
